mapper.sql: id, user_id, drug_name, dose_time, dosage, note, enabled, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_reminder (user_id, drug_name, dose_time, dosage, note, enabled, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{drugName}, #{doseTime}, #{dosage}, #{note}, #{enabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE medication_reminder SET drug_name = #{drugName}, dose_time = #{doseTime}, dosage = #{dosage}, note = #{note}, enabled = #{enabled, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medication_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY dose_time ASC
SELECT FROM medication_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY dose_time ASC
